column3: NASB renders “gave up” as “delivered up” and “grant” as “freely give.”
NASB follows the critical text (“Christ Jesus”); it adds “yes.”
The quotation is in capitals; “we face death” is rendered “WE ARE BEING PUT TO DEATH.”
NASB renders “we more than conquer” as “we overwhelmingly conquer.”
NASB renders “I have been persuaded” as “I am convinced.”
